notes.title: Patch 2.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed the grease gun in the diner. Now it's no longer just floating there.
[*]Slightly faster repair barrier time
[*]Fixed bug where cows could walk through doors at the gas station
[*]Converted many audio from mp3 to wav in hopes of fixing audio glitches/clipping
[*]Tweak cow difficulty on higher levels. Now they should be less tanky
[*]Replaced and added several sound effects
[/list]
